text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 12, January 14, 1936 ]
RESERVE OF 5 PER CENT OF THE APPROPRIATIONS AUTHORIZED FOR THE YEAR 1936
WHEREAS it has been reported by the Secretary of Finance that in revising the budget for the current year
nineteen hundred and thirty-six, in order to include the supplemental appropriations authorized by the various
Commonwealth Acts recently enacted, the general appropriations authorized under Act Numbered Four
thousand two hundred and thirty-one amounting to forty-three million two hundred four thousand three
hundred fourteen pesos and ten centavos was reduced by an amount corresponding to a reserve of five per
cent of the authorized appropriations, excluding the appropriations exempted from the reserve as provided for
WHEREAS it is necessary to make a reserve of five per cent of the appropriation in order that the amount
needed to cover the total authorized ordinary expenditures for this year will not be in excess of the total
estimated regular income during the year;
NOW, THEREFORE, pursuant to the provisions of section seven of Act Numbered Four thousand one
hundred and eighty-seven, General Appropriation Act for nineteen hundred and thirty-five, which was
amended and made applicable for the year nineteen hundred and thirty-one and Commonwealth Act
Numbered Nineteen, a reduction of five per cent of the appropriations authorized in said Acts shall be made
from the amounts available for all departments, bureaus, and offices of the Insular Government, unless
otherwise specifically exempted in said Acts.
Done at the City of Manila, this fourteenth day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-six, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the first.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEOFILO SISON
Secretary of the Interior
